test_title: PYST 6: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question: **What are the weaknesses of traditional Indian firms?**

options.text: Ingrained ways of thinking and adoption of modern practices of management
A weakness for quick profit and the openness to acquiring wealth
A lack of team work and the cut-throat competition
A lack of team work and a weakness for quick profit

solution:
The correct answer is: **A lack of team work and a weakness for quick profit**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The weaknesses of traditional Indian firms are highlighted in the paragraph.
 
• The **third sentence of the paragraph states**, "*Traditional Indian firms have their strengths, but also their weaknesses, and of these perhaps the most debilitating are a lack of team work and a weakness for quick profit.*"
 
• This sentence explicitly mentions two weaknesses of traditional Indian firms: **a lack of teamwork and a weakness for quick profit.**

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.
